lim_001: You can recognise it as the cedar standing on the pavement in front of Chabuca Granda's former house. It stands on Avenida 28 de Julio, block 6, in Miraflores.
lim_002: You can recognise it as the olive standing beside the Casa Museo Marina Nunez del Prado, inside the old colonial grove. It stands in Bosque El Olivar, San Isidro.
lim_003: You can recognise it by its swollen grey trunk, soft rather than woody, holding up a crown some 25 to 30 metres across. It stands in Parque El Carmen, in Pueblo Libre.
lim_004: You can recognise it by its wide buttress roots and tropical crown, unlike anything else in this desert city. It stands in the green entrance strip of Parque Ernesto Alayza Grundy.
lim_005: You can recognise it as the tall conifer towering over the surrounding olive grove, leaning slightly. It stands at the corner of Calle 24 de Abril and Calle Las Amazonas, in Bosque El Olivar.
